description: This file defines a REST controller for handling document-related operations in a receipt and expense management platform. It includes endpoints for uploading documents, adding new versions, retrieving documents by ID, searching documents, and categorizing documents.

classes.name: DocumentController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for uploading, retrieving, searching, and categorizing documents within the application.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a new document, including running OCR and auto-categorization, and creating the initial version.

methods.name: addVersion
methods.description: Allows adding a new version to an existing document, re-running OCR and categorization processes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a document by its ID, including all its versions.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search over documents based on free text and optional filters.

methods.name: categorize
methods.description: Manually sets or overrides the category of a specific document.
